notes.title: THE MAGISTER – NEW NERDOOK GAME IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]It's sleuthin' and deducin' time! The Magister - the new game from Reverse Crawl developer, Nerdook - has finally arrived and there's a murder to solve in Silverhurst! [/b] Step into the shoes of a Magister, gather clues, discover motives, and unmask the guilty culprit! Build a deck and use a vast array of cards to fight or negotiate! 

[list]
[*] Randomly generated murder-mystery means every playthrough is different!
[*] Use physical, weapon, and magic cards to overpower enemies in battle
[*] Master 'Tactical Diplomacy' with conversation cards for peaceful outcomes
[*] Variety of Magisters to play as, each with their own specialties and flaws
[*] Recruit an ally to help, including a cat or dog companion to fight alongside you 
[/list]
The Magister is available to purchase and download now from the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/]store page[/url][/b], and you can grab it with a 15% launch discount for a limited time. You can also pick it up on Nintendo Switch, and it'll arrive tomorrow (3rd Sept) on Xbox One.

[previewyoutube=JqCM-C5IbZg;full][/previewyoutube]
For a taster of what The Magister has to offer, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716720/The_Magister__The_First_Two_Days/]download The Magister: The First Two Days for free here[/url]. It gives you the first two days of an investigation to play through (in the full game, investigations take place over 14 days).

We hope you enjoy The Magister! If you do, please leave a review – it really helps. Thank you for the support!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304770/The_Magister/

notes.title: Join the PC Gamer Club today and get a copy of Reverse Crawl
notes.notes:
As you might've already noticed, we launched the PC Gamer Club earlier this year. But if you didn't, let us tell that signing up gets you a digital subscription to PC Gamer magazine, ad-free-browsing on this very site, and monthly game keys—the latest of which, as the headline above suggests, is Nerdook Productions and Digerati Distribution's Reverse Crawl. 

Offering an interesting twist on the dungeon-crawling formula, this turn-based RPG lets you set minions on the game's heroes, and features a branching storyline with a dynamic campaign, giving you a bunch of ways to play. At the time of writing, Reverse Crawl boasts a 91 percent positive review rating on Steam, and we hope you enjoy it. This offers comes courtesy of retailer BundleStars.com. 

More information on the PC Gamer Club itself can be located via our Club FAQ, while sign-up forms can be found in this direction. Existing Club members will of course receive Reverse Crawl at no extra cost.

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the third update for Reverse Crawl: 

Changelog v 1.0.0.3
================ 

- Fixed the Cache mission and remaining Siren bugs. 
- Added an Upgrade Tree. Accessible from the main quest screen and after missions, it allows you to have greater control over your upgrades and specializations. Each level up grants you points that you can spend in one of six upgrade categories!
- Rebalanced the Endless mode to scale better over time.

Mini update (15 Oct)
- Fixed Marksman level 1 in the Upgrade Tree.
- Reworked New Game+ a little: all heroes are now available from the start (except for the final two classes), and the hero missions have been reworked/removed in New Game+

As always, if you come across any new bugs or have some feedback, head along to the community forums and let me know! Thanks guys!

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the second update for Reverse Crawl:

Changelog v 1.0.0.2
================

- Guard command nerfed. It now heals less damage, and damage reduction from the next missile is reduced to 35% from 50% originally.
- Reworked the "Threatening" trait to only trigger with a 15% chance each round. It was way too powerful before, and has been toned down now.
- Reworked the "Holy Light" ability, it now only has a 33% chance to reduce 1 Threat, instead of 100% chance of reducing Threat by 2 originally.
- Fixed Cache mission: choosing Violet early will no longer make the mission unwinnable
- Fixed Siren bug: having no enemies remaining when dominated will no longer freeze the game
- You can now alt-tab out of the game without it crashing.
- Various smaller bug fixes.

As always, if you come across any new bugs or have some feedback, head along to the community forums and let me know! Thanks guys!

notes.title: Reverse Crawl Update! v1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey guys, I've uploaded the first update for Reverse Crawl:

Changelog v 1.0.0.1
================

- You can now use the Guard command even when Stunned, so that you can always skip a turn by Guarding instead. It can even be used if there is a Magehunter on the field.
- Fixed Sirens so that a dominated creature's turn automatically ends when there are no enemies left on the field.

I've got bigger changes planned in future updates, so stay tuned! In the meantime, keep leaving reviews if you enjoy the game, take some screenshots, and feel free to ask questions on the discussion boards. Cheers!
